overall: Atlanta saw a hotter-than-expected day, with temperatures climbing to a running max of 91.4°F in the mid-to-late afternoon before a sharp drop to 80.6°F at 17:52 ET, likely due to convective activity or an outflow boundary. By 22:30 ET the temperature has cooled further to 78.8°F and is declining at -1.8°F/hr — the diurnal heating cycle is definitively over.
